description: Howling winter storm ambient sounds: Imagine you are warm and cosy in your bed listening to the howling wind and heavy snow outside. These winter sounds are the perfect background for sleeping and relaxing. Enjoy mother nature at her best! My own recording is mixed with the following sounds: https://freesound.org/people/Jeffreys2/sounds/327772 https://freesound.org/people/Jeffreys2/sounds/327771 https://freesound.org/people/felix.blume/sounds/211463 https://freesound.org/people/krnd/sounds/90898/ https://freesound.org/people/courter/sounds/447823/ I have editing and mixing these sounds together. (Thank you all for the beautiful sounds).
